title: Constrained Quarter-Wave Bragg Stack with ±10% Thickness Bounds
scientific_hypothesis: Initializing layer thicknesses at nominal quarter-wave optical thickness (λ₀/4n_i) for the visible stopband center (~550 nm) with ±10% optimization bounds will reduce early-round exploration entropy and allow the optimizer to resolve interference stacking order before adjusting absolute spacing, improving convergence toward the dual-band objective.
design_principle: Quarter-wave dielectric stack with high-index (HfO2) and low-index (SiO2) alternating layers, starting with high-index on substrate. Outer layers modified for environmental durability. Thickness initialization centered on λ₀/4n_i with bounded optimization.
proposed_topology: Air | [HfO2 | SiO2] × 7 | Fused Silica substrate (14 finite layers total)
design_variables: Layer thicknesses (14 variables, each bounded to ±10% of nominal quarter-wave value at 550 nm)
theory_basis: Quarter-wave optical thickness (λ₀/4n) layers form high-reflection stopbands
Alternating high/low index materials maximize reflectance per layer pair
Outer layer modifications improve environmental durability
expected_advantages: Reduced optimization search space via constrained initialization
Faster convergence to local optimum near quarter-wave design
known_risks: May converge to local optimum that does not fully address dual-band requirement
Quarter-wave design centered on visible may not optimize 1530-1565 nm transmittance
execution_request_english: Optimize a 14-layer HfO2/SiO2 alternating stack on Fused Silica substrate with Air incident medium. Initialize thicknesses at nominal quarter-wave values (λ₀=550 nm center of visible stopband): HfO2 layers at 550/(4×n_HfO2), SiO2 layers at 550/(4×n_SiO2). Apply ±10% bounds on each thickness during optimization. Layer sequence: HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 (14 finite layers). Optimize for maximum transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band and maximum reflectance in 400-700 nm band. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1530-1565 nm, 400-700 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band; High reflectance in 400-700 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band; Low transmittance in 400-700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Maximum 30 layers.
revision_reason: Replace broad initialization with constrained sampling centered on nominal quarter-wave values (λ₀/4n_i) at 550 nm with ±10% bounds per layer, as directed by feedback. This reduces early-round exploration entropy while preserving the 14-layer Bragg stack topology from route_01.
